question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Divulgence
solution:
The correct answer is "**Repudiation**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Divulgence**" is the act of making something publicly known; telling people something that was secret. (प्रकटीकरण) 

 
 
• **Example**- The divulgence of his secret identity put him in danger.
 
 
 
• "**Repudiation**" means the rejection of a proposal or idea. (अस्वीकार)
 
 
• **Example**- His repudiation of the claim shocked everyone.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is "Repudiation".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's have a look at the meanings of the remaining options.
 
• "**Revelation**" denotes a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others. (प्रकटीकरण)
 
• "**Assertion**" signifies a confident and forceful statement of fact or belief. (दावा)
 
• "**Confirmation**" refers to the action of making sure or demonstrating that something is true or accurate. (पुष्टि)
